systems.system: Planned integrated education ecosystem of interoperable information systems and digital platforms (MINEDU-NC and FDSU memorandum, 2 April 2026)
systems.owner: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale et Nouvelle Citoyenneté (MINEDU-NC), with FDSU
systems.tiers: planned for central administration, provincial administrations, managing offices and schools

note: A memorandum of 2 April 2026 under the ministry's 2024-2029 five-year plan, aiming at interconnection, interoperable platforms and centralised, traceable school data; it names no existing system and does not say what any system does.
